blocks.title: Moss & Salt · Saturday 16:30
blocks.summary: Confirmed fixture booking for three; stroller space requested.
blocks.content: Allow 20 minutes to walk back from the garden. Keep the booking message saved. The restaurant is the only fixed paid commitment.

blocks.title: Library makers' room, Sunday 15:00
blocks.summary: Use only if showers arrive or the group needs a quieter plan.
blocks.content: Bring the membership card and one small craft kit. Cancel the room without cost before 14:30.

blocks.title: Decision rule
blocks.content: If rain starts before Sunday lunch, keep the market short and reserve the library room by 12:00.
